title: The town's own checks stop waiting on pictures nobody looks at
items: Nothing you can see changes. Two of the checks run on every change were timing out. They read the Evidence panel and the People and Businesses lists, but each step also waited for the whole 3D town to be drawn, and on the test machines one picture of the town takes nearly eight seconds. Those checks now pause the drawing while they read the panels, which is how the other picture-free checks already work. The town is drawn again before anything that looks at it.
